environment_limits: LeakSanitizerはptrace環境で終了時に失敗するため、成功したASan/UBSan検証はASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0。失敗記録を保持し、所有権のライブ数・確保失敗試験も別途確認。
Potential提出に展開する外部ACLは__int128宣言を含むため-pedantic-errorsを外してビルド。本体単独の標準演算経路は独立テストで-pedantic-errors付きで検証。

vendor_build_note.result: external ACL vendor rejected -pedantic-errors for its __int128 declarations
vendor_build_note.resolution: Potential driver including ACL uses -Wall -Wextra -Werror without -pedantic-errors. Owned library standard arithmetic is tested separately under -pedantic-errors by the independent suite. No vendor or library source changed.
